title: Why site November 5 was targeted
place_text: Site November 5, Ellsworth AFB missile field, South Dakota

tellings.quote: why November 5, the closest to a town, the closest to the launch control facility and the least amount of travel time for all other nine missiles?

plain: Something picked one particular nuclear missile site, called November 5, in the missile field of Ellsworth Air Force Base in South Dakota in 1977, and it picked it for a reason. Mario Woods, an Air Force veteran who says he was taken by aliens there, asks why it was November 5 and answers his own question: it was the closest to a town, the closest to the launch control center, and the quickest to reach from all the other nine missiles. In his view the choice shows planning by whoever was behind the encounter.
